subject: history
concept: Analyzing how empires expanded and administered diverse territories and peoples
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple physical map showing an empire's expansion over several stages
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an administrative method (governors, tribute systems, roads) to the empire that used it
exercise.abstract: Student explains one method a described empire used to govern its expanded territory

misconception_flags: assumes all empires expanded and governed identically regardless of context

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
